q1_issues.issue: The fused compound kinds new_moon and full_moon carry none of their mandatory decomposition atoms — the always-emitted genus (Inheritance new_moon moon) / (Inheritance full_moon moon), plus the modifier genus, since "new" and "full" are adjectives predicable of the moon.

q2_gaps: temporal proximity to a named time or lunar phase ("occur near new moon"): the Time section offers Time / Before / BeforeBy / TimeAtLeast / TimeAtMost / During but no nearness relation, so the parse falls back on the entity-attached spatial-preposition head for what is a temporal relation

a coordination that enumerates alternative occasions ("near new moon and full moon"): default-distributive "and" replicates the predication onto one and the same tide, asserting it is near both phases at once, and no licensed form says "each occurrence near one or the other"
notes: Suppressing an occur event is correct per the light-verbs-over-event-nouns rule, and Near is the preposition actually used, so it stays inside the entity-attached surface-preposition licence. Rule shape, 0.9/0.9 empirical TV, absent status atom and absent QuantifierPhrase are all right.
